items.title: Florian J. "Curly" Lizana Interview, 1966-05-18
items.q: every time he got an opportunity done, he'd make me sit down and he wanted to teach me.

ctx.x: Yeah. You want to drink, Big O? No, so I want to talk to him. And every time he got an opportunity done, he'd make me sit down and he wanted to teach me. He knew. I told him no. I said, Big O, I don't want to play that kind of thing. I said, it's nice. I appreciate all that, but I don't want to play. But that's how we got to acquire that. He told me, he said, get your volume system playing. I'll let you play a whole lot more than you are now. And that's how I come in and get a volume system.
Did you execute more than that? No, I didn't. You could play more than that.
